flows:
Navigate to https://www.whatmobile.com.pk/ then Work exclusively inside the Reading view dialog.
Use the exact listed role and name for the requested control.
Test the exact target and report the outcome once.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, send or submit anything, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
In Reading view, find the “Search” textbox and type test without submitting.
Get the outcome of typing test in the “Search” textbox in Reading view and save it as {{search_textbox_outcome}}.
